The world

The world is the part the company cannot see. It replays the real 2016–25 record and draws its households fresh every run. What reaches the company is only what crosses the wall at the bottom.

Read each column top to bottom, from cause to what follows. The mark in each box is read from the maturity map at publish: . done, _ in build, ~ not started.

Where to see it working

  • Capabilities — what the company can do with what crosses, each line with its test.
  • How it’s built — the rules that keep the world honest and the wall shut.
  • Explore — the drawn households and their bills, one at a time.
  • The code — the world’s modules, and the one seam the company reads through.
